## 56. Repository 117 bottom line
**Repository 117 `Apple-Publication` is best understood as publication-oriented Apple/network experiment automation and analysis package.**
A publication-oriented research tooling repository that packages laptop FTP clients, an iperf3 suite, server-side automation, packet-capture support and browser-based finish-time/throughput processing. It represents a move from exploratory FTP automation toward repeatable comparative experiment tooling. However, the server AutomationStarter file is byte-identical to Repo110 starter.py, so longitudinal credit is assigned to packaging, extensions and new experiment components rather than duplicate code volume.
**Product/engineering maturity:** 4.0/5.
**Portfolio Evidence Weight:** 4.9/5.
### Strongest defensible claims
- network experiment orchestration — 4.7/5 (direct)
- FTP trial automation — 4.6/5 (direct)
- iperf3 experiment automation — 4.5/5 (direct)
- packet-capture workflow integration — 4.2/5 (direct)
- result processing and comparative analysis — 4.5/5 (direct)
- research-tool packaging and reuse — 4.5/5 (direct)
### Critical caveats
- accepted peer-reviewed publication
- novel FTP protocol implementation
- new authorship credit for byte-identical Repo110 automation
- Apple networking-stack implementation
- carry-forward code can inflate apparent project size
- FTP credentials/test defaults need strict lab-only treatment
- experiment variants can drift in configuration
### Career effect
Extends the FTP/networking lineage into a more research-method-oriented package. The career signal shifts from “can automate transfers” toward “can build repeatable comparative network experiments,” while duplicate-code controls prevent false growth.

sections.title: Critical caveats
sections.content:
- accepted peer-reviewed publication
- novel FTP protocol implementation
- new authorship credit for byte-identical Repo110 automation
- Apple networking-stack implementation
- carry-forward code can inflate apparent project size
- FTP credentials/test defaults need strict lab-only treatment
- experiment variants can drift in configuration

sections.title: Career effect
sections.content: Extends the FTP/networking lineage into a more research-method-oriented package. The career signal shifts from “can automate transfers” toward “can build repeatable comparative network experiments,” while duplicate-code controls prevent false growth.
